text:
anna_marketing: Hey runtime team — planning launch posts + webinar next week. Need a short spotprobe on the benchmark numbers we intend to show. Can you validate the figures and hand off minimal reproducible payloads/traces? Key asks: 1) coldstart p95 for quantized vs fp16, 2) tiny sample payloads (<=128 tokens) and warmup recipe, 3) raw traces for warm vs cold for the slide callouts. cc @sam_runtime @leo_eng :pray:

sam_runtime: On it. Can you drop which endpoints and the exact model variants you're planning to cite?

anna_marketing: Claim is "Redwood inference: ~2x lower per-token cost for gen4-small-quant vs baseline" on hosted. Model variants to test: rwd-gen4-small-quant and rwd-gen4-small-fp16. Endpoint: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate (region: us-west1, hosted-prod).

leo_eng: Quick heads-up — quantized perf is sensitive to batch size and warmup. What's the batch/concurrency we should mimic? For lead-facing claims we usually measure batch_size=1 and concurrency=1 to reflect single-request UX.

maria_prod: For the webinar demo let's standardize a 3-example prompt set (friendly Q/A + succinct system instruction). I'll paste the 3 payloads we want below so bench outputs match slides.

maria_prod: ```json
[
  {"input":"Write a 20-word summary of Redwood Inference's advantage for a non-technical product manager."},
  {"input":"List 3 reasons platform teams choose a unified runtime for inference."},
  {"input":"Generate a 2-sentence elevator pitch for our hosted API focusing on latency and cost."}
]
```

sam_runtime: Got it. We'll run a compact sweep: coldstart (fresh node, no KV cache), short steady-state (10s at qps=2), and longer steady (2min at qps=5) just to show stability. We'll produce: a) p50/p95/p99 latency CSV, b) token-cost numbers, c) raw trace snippets (timestamps + trace ids) and d) a tiny repro bundle (payloads + run script). ETA: EOD today.

sam_runtime: Repro run command we'll use (so you can copy it into docs):
```bash
./bench/run.sh --model rwd-gen4-small-quant 
  --endpoint https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  --payloads marketing/payloads.json 
  --warmup 30 
  --duration 120 
  --concurrency 1
```

benchbot: benchmark job 1798123460 created for rwd-gen4-small-quant, status: queued.

sam_runtime: Note — hosted-prod can show autoscaler variance on coldstart numbers. We'll capture raw traces and also provide a reproducible Docker image + local command so marketing can reproduce the number in a controlled environment (no autoscaling).

anna_marketing: That's perfect. Two asks before you run: 1) include a one-paragraph plain-language caveat we can paste under the slide, and 2) give exact commands to reproduce locally (no cloud autoscaler). :thumbsup:

sam_runtime: Will do. We'll attach the caveat and a small section called "how to reproduce (local)" with the docker image tag and exact run command. I'll ping when artifacts are uploaded.

deploy-bot: artifact upload started for job 1798123460 -> s3://bench-outputs/marketing/1798123460/ (presigned link will be available).

sam_runtime: Uploaded artifacts and short README. Link: https://s3.redwood.ai/marketing/1798123460/ (includes CSVs, traces, payloads.json, and repro Dockerfile). I'll follow up with a tiny summary message you can paste into the slide notes.

anna_marketing: Amazing — thanks everyone. We'll slot the summary into the hero slide and the caveat into speaker notes. If anything surprising shows up in the traces, flag it here and we'll hold the line-item.

sam_runtime: Will do.
